## 📚 Documentation Issue

A clear and concise description of the documentation issue.

## 📍 Location

Where is the documentation issue located?
- File/Page: [e.g., README.md, docs/api_reference.md]
- Section: [e.g., Installation, API Reference]
- Line/Heading: [e.g., Line 42, "Getting Started" section]

## 🔍 Issue Type

Select the type of documentation issue:
- [ ] Incorrect or outdated information
- [ ] Missing documentation
- [ ] Unclear or confusing explanation
- [ ] Broken links or references
- [ ] Typo or grammar issue
- [ ] Missing code example
- [ ] Other (please describe)

## 📝 Current State

What does the documentation currently say? (if applicable)

```
Quote the current documentation here
```

## ✅ Suggested Improvement

What should the documentation say instead? How can it be improved?

```
Provide your suggested changes here
```

## 🎯 Reason for Change

Why is this change necessary? How does it improve the documentation?

## 📖 Additional Context

Add any other context, examples, or screenshots about the documentation issue.

## ✔️ Checklist

- [ ] I have checked the latest version of the documentation
- [ ] I have searched existing issues to ensure this isn't a duplicate
- [ ] I have provided specific location information
- [ ] I am willing to submit a PR to fix this (optional)
